subject: MedNova DPIA template submission and proposed response plan
messages:
From: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@mednova.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Samuel Ortiz <sam.ortiz@mednova.com>, MedNova DPO <dpo@mednova.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: MedNova DPIA template submission

Hi Diego,

Thanks for agreeing to take a look at our DPIA. Attached is our standard DPIA template (MedNova_DPIA_Template_v2.xlsx). We need Redwood to fill the sections that describe processing activities, risk mitigations, data flows, and cross-border transfers.

Key asks:
- Can you confirm which Redwood services will process or store personal data and any PHI elements we should be aware of?
- Confirm whether Redwood relies on Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and provide a redline or pointer to your DPA.
- Provide evidence for technical measures (logging, access controls, encryption) and a high-level processing map.

Requested timeline: 10 business days from receipt. If you need more time, please let us know a preferred target.

We also have a brief HIPAA inquiry in section 7 of the template; please flag if there are any limitations handling PHI.

Thanks,
Lydia Chen
Senior Privacy Manager
MedNova Health
Attachments: MedNova_DPIA_Template_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42 KB)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@mednova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MedNova DPIA template submission

Hi Lydia,

Received with thanks. Plan we propose:
- Day 1-2: Redwood will map template sections to internal owners and identify gaps (Diego + Laura).
- Day 3-4: Legal will prepare redline language for SCCs/DPA and confirm subprocessors (Marissa).
- Day 5-7: Collect supporting evidence (screenshots, logging extracts, summary statements) and assemble a single evidence pack.

Preliminary answers to your bullets:
- Services in-scope: Hosted inference API (text generation, embeddings), request/response logs retained per our retention schedule, optional dedicated capacity products if customer opts in.
- SCCs and DPA: Redwood uses SCCs with a standard DPA; Marissa will provide the Annex A and proposed redlines.
- HIPAA: We support regulated workloads via Private deployments and signed BAAs as an add-on; we will flag any limitations in the template.

We should be able to deliver a completed template and evidence bundle within 7 business days, assuming no additional scope is requested. If MedNova requires PHI to be processed in the hosted environment without a BAA, that will add steps.

I will share a mapping CSV and a Drive folder later today with the requested artifacts.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: MedNova DPIA template submission

Marissa, Laura, forwarding MedNova's template and initial ask. Internal notes below.

Action items for internal owners:
- Marissa: draft DPA redlines and SCC commentary; call out any non-standard clauses (data subject rights, audit windows, retention caps). Please include a short paragraph we can paste into the template for question 4.
- Laura: produce a one-page processing map (Processing-Map.png) and a short evidence summary for encryption, RBAC, audit logging, and retention policy. Also pull the last 30-day token-level telemetry sample (anonymized) to show logging exists.
- Diego: I'll compile the mapping CSV (DPIA_Mapping_MedNova.csv) and assemble the Drive folder and Jira ticket for tracking.

Timeline: 48 working hours for initial drafts to share back to me. If either of you foresee blockers, flag them in-channel.

Thanks,
Diego
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: MedNova DPIA template submission

Diego, Laura,

Attached are the initial legal artifacts I will include: Redwood_DPA_AnnexA.pdf and a commentary doc SCCs-Annotation.docx. High-level notes:
- SCCs: we will confirm which module set we intend to rely on and provide the clause references; propose a short addition re: subprocessors and notification timelines.
- Retention: mednova asks for specifics. I propose we provide our standard retention tiers and offer an optional shorter retention window for log exports if they require.
- PHI/HIPAA: we will not sign a BAA for hosted shared-tier customers; however we can support PHI under Dedicated or Private with an executed BAA addendum. Will include explicit text for question 7.

I will upload redline snippets to the Drive folder and add comments for the template cell references. Expect my draft by end of day tomorrow.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_DPA_AnnexA.pdf, SCCs-Annotation.docx
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@mednova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Samuel Ortiz <sam.ortiz@mednova.com>, MedNova DPO <dpo@mednova.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MedNova DPIA template submission - mapping and evidence pack

Lydia, Sam,

Thanks for the template. Attached is our completed mapping CSV and a Drive folder with the supporting artifacts. Summary of what we provided:

1) Completed template cells: we filled sections describing processing activities, legal basis, international transfers, and mitigations. See DPIA_Mapping_MedNova.csv for row-level mapping to Redwood owners.

2) Legal: Redwood_DPA_AnnexA.pdf and SCCs-Annotation.docx with suggested redlines and callouts. Marissa flagged retention and subprocessors as negotiable items.

3) Technical evidence: Processing-Map.png, short summary statements for encryption at rest/in transit, RBAC and audit logging screenshots, and an anonymized telemetry extract.

4) Next steps and asks for MedNova:
   - Please confirm whether you require a BAA or if processing will avoid PHI in the hosted environment. If you require a BAA, we will route to contracts for a Dedicated/Private deployment conversation.
   - Review the SCC notes and mark any clauses you need us to escalate.
   - If the 7-business-day timeline is insufficient, let us know and we will extend but that may push the delivery by 3-5 days.

Drive folder (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example
Jira ticket: SEC-4321 (internal tracking of evidence delivery)

Attachments: DPIA_Mapping_MedNova.csv (mapping), plus the redlines and evidence in the Drive folder.

Best regards,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
